tasks.title: Compare three architecture candidates for certified UPLC verification
tasks.description: Write an experiment proposal comparing certified symbolic execution, compositional weakest-precondition generation, and a certificate-producing solver portfolio. Architecture is unconstrained. Use current repository facts; distinguish hypotheses from measured results. Do not edit code or publish externally.
acceptance: Three candidate approaches with a concrete falsifiable experiment each
Original-theorem proof path and expected bottleneck for each
A bounded first experiment with a stop condition
No invented benchmark measurements or claims of Cardano correspondence

tasks.title: Audit the compiled-contract semantic path and trust dependencies
tasks.description: Propose an audit of CardanoLedgerApiBlaster and PlutusCoreBlaster: source provenance, decoding, preprocessing correctness, evaluation bounds, builtins, cryptographic assumptions, and conformance. This is an audit plan, not a claim of completed correspondence.
acceptance: Enumerate semantic bridges and required proof obligations
Separate fuel exhaustion, failure, and success
Include a non-vacuity strategy
Identify a reproducible initial contract target

tasks.title: Freeze the first external comparison corpus
tasks.description: Select and pin external program-verification cases, including Blaster-compatible cases and new contract families. Record licenses and source hashes; keep solver success separate from certified proof success.
acceptance: Pinned sources with license and extraction provenance
Family-balanced cases and full-contract scoring
Same-toolchain comparison or explicit incompatibility
No benchmark-name special casing

tasks.title: Implement the winning bounded proof-engine experiment
tasks.description: Implement the selected experiment after independent review of its research proposal and frozen challenge set. The pilot tactic is disposable; do not preserve its architecture for its own sake.
acceptance: Reconstruct original theorem proofs
Report all failures and complete timings
Independent review of semantic changes
Public implementation PR with reproduction evidence

tasks.title: Move acceptance into an independent sandboxed evaluator
tasks.description: Port to a suitable modern pinned Lean and evaluate lake comparator/check with external kernels. Keep trusted challenge/configuration outside worker authority. Add VM/container isolation and a narrow publication broker.
acceptance: Reject changed theorem statements and nonstandard axioms
Replay exports in a fresh trusted process
Verify independent kernels on representative proofs
Document remaining trusted components and platform requirements

tasks.title: Specify the Plutus Gauntlet batch marketplace
tasks.description: Specify payment allocation, unique obligations, cancellation, assets, and malformed inputs for an exact compiled marketplace script. Include vulnerable variants and successful witness transactions.
acceptance: Compiled-script hash and language version
Explicit semantic correspondence scope and bounds
Valid-transaction witnesses
Replayable multi-satisfaction counterexample for a vulnerable variant

tasks.title: Add bounded Boolean case splitting to the proof portfolio
tasks.description: Implement a generic deterministic fallback for one Boolean parameter after the arithmetic portfolio fails and before structural induction. Split that parameter into false/true and attempt the existing simplification/arithmetic portfolio on every branch. Backtrack fully if either branch remains open. Keep all original theorem statements, seeds, comparator, evaluator, toolchain and CI unchanged. Add a small Lean module under Colony/Examples with positive checks for Boolean branching (for example a natural-valued conditional whose result must equal one of two branches), an ordinary arithmetic regression, and a deliberately invalid goal that the tactic must fail to close. Import the example module from Colony.lean so lake build checks it. No model calls at tactic runtime, names special-casing, new axioms, native_decide, sorry, or admit. Record exact local checks in a concise research note.
acceptance: Generic bounded Boolean fallback with complete backtracking and ordinary proof terms
New example module is imported and checked by lake build, including positive and invalid-goal regression checks
Existing seed statements and all protected acceptance files remain unchanged
Actual Lean checks and limitations are recorded; no benchmark superiority or Cardano verification claim
